table_dictionary.formula: lambda(t)=exp(a+d*z(t)-eta*g(t))+n*h(t); z(t)=2*t/24394-1; eta=0 and/or n=0 for absent components
table_dictionary.time: 86400 SI seconds per UTC day since 1960-01-01T00:00:00Z, Python datetime without leap seconds; window [0,24394), end-exclusive 2026-10-15; no per-fold rescaling
table_dictionary.mark: excess=magnitude-5; native GeoNet preferred magnitude with original magnitude_type, no homogenisation; iteration_5/code/prepare_catalogue.py:103-104,363-365
table_dictionary.a: log background rate when z=0 and g=0, using one day as time unit; exp(a) has units day^-1
table_dictionary.d: dimensionless coefficient of z(t); physical slope 2*d/24394 day^-1 would be newly derived and is not substituted
table_dictionary.n: dimensionless mean productivity multiplier of unit-mean mark productivity under fitted exponential mark law
table_dictionary.eta: dimensionless coefficient of g=sum exp(gamma*(excess-1))*Phi(lag); fixed gamma=.75*log(10)
table_dictionary.beta_train: exponential rate per magnitude unit; N_train/sum(training excess), fitted only on strict training prefix, frozen across test and common to families
table_dictionary.ratio: dimensionless r; mark productivity=(1-r)*exp(beta_train*r*excess); grid selected, distinct from beta and n
table_dictionary.alpha: dimensionless Mittag-Leffler kernel shape grid winner; not trigger productivity exponent
table_dictionary.tau: Mittag-Leffler scale in days; Omori raw trigger.tau is reporting c in days
table_dictionary.p: dimensionless Omori decay exponent, continuous winner; ML trigger.p is inactive serialization default
table_dictionary.log_c: natural logarithm of Omori c measured in days, saved optimizer coordinate
table_dictionary.training_ground_nll: negative event-time/ground-rate log likelihood evaluated with observed marked history; excludes common mark-density term
